Major release with K-Score v10, Harmony economic system, and comprehensive security hardening.

---

## K-Score v10

Pure geometric mean formula:
```
K = 100 × ∛(D × O × L)
```

| Pillar | Components |
|--------|------------|
| **D (Diamond Hands)** | Conviction score, accumulator ratio, activity freshness |
| **O (Organic Growth)** | Real holders ($1+), distribution fairness |
| **L (Longevity)** | Token age, survival factor |

### Credit Rating
| K-Score | Grade | Rating |
|---------|-------|--------|
| 90+ | 💎 Diamond | A1 Prime |
| 80-89 | 💠 Platinum | A2 Excellent |
| 70-79 | 🥇 Gold | A3 Good |
| 60-69 | 🥈 Silver | B1 Fair |
| 50-59 | 🥉 Bronze | B2 Speculative |
| 40-49 | 🟤 Copper | B3 Risky |
| 20-39 | ⚫ Iron | C High Risk |
| 0-19 | 🔩 Rust | D Junk |

---

## Harmony E-Score System

φ-based (1.618) economic engine for GASdf integration.

- **E-Score**: 7-dimension engagement scoring
- **Oracle API**: Token acceptance + discount calculation
- **Discounts**: Up to 90% based on E-Score
- **Fee Distribution**: 38.2% burn / 38.2% rewards / 23.6% treasury

### Oracle Endpoints
```
GET /oracle/kscore/:mint      # Token acceptance check
GET /oracle/discount/:wallet  # Wallet discount calculation
```

---

## Security Hardening

### Data Integrity
- 8-category HMAC signatures (Identity, Security, LP, Supply, K-Score, Market, Origin, Full)
- Chaos nonce for unpredictability
- Self-healing integrity watchdog
- 42-column token schema

### Protection
- Unified rate limiting + burn credits
- Data verification layer ("Don't Trust, Verify")
- Comprehensive audit fixes (OWASP top 10)

---

## Features

### Card Generator v4
- 3 styles: HolDex (glassmorphism), ASDF (fire), Minimal (dark)
- 2x rendering for crisp output

### Dashboards
- `/cult-space` - Cult member dashboard with wallet auth
- `/track-record` - Trencher's Dashboard redesign
- `/admin` - Grant management

### Infrastructure
- PriceWorker with DexScreener batch API
- Helius webhook integration
- Discord alerting for credits & tampering

Major release with K-Score v10, Harmony economic system, and comprehensive security hardening.

---

## K-Score v10

Pure geometric mean formula:
```
K = 100 × ∛(D × O × L)
```

| Pillar | Components |
|--------|------------|
| **D (Diamond Hands)** | Conviction score, accumulator ratio, activity freshness |
| **O (Organic Growth)** | Real holders ($1+), distribution fairness |
| **L (Longevity)** | Token age, survival factor |

### Credit Rating
| K-Score | Grade | Rating |
|---------|-------|--------|
| 90+ | 💎 Diamond | A1 Prime |
| 80-89 | 💠 Platinum | A2 Excellent |
| 70-79 | 🥇 Gold | A3 Good |
| 60-69 | 🥈 Silver | B1 Fair |
| 50-59 | 🥉 Bronze | B2 Speculative |
| 40-49 | 🟤 Copper | B3 Risky |
| 20-39 | ⚫ Iron | C High Risk |
| 0-19 | 🔩 Rust | D Junk |

---

## Harmony E-Score System

φ-based (1.618) economic engine for GASdf integration.

- **E-Score**: 7-dimension engagement scoring
- **Oracle API**: Token acceptance + discount calculation
- **Discounts**: Up to 90% based on E-Score
- **Fee Distribution**: 38.2% burn / 38.2% rewards / 23.6% treasury

### Oracle Endpoints
```
GET /oracle/kscore/:mint      # Token acceptance check
GET /oracle/discount/:wallet  # Wallet discount calculation
```

---

## Security Hardening

### Data Integrity
- 8-category HMAC signatures (Identity, Security, LP, Supply, K-Score, Market, Origin, Full)
- Chaos nonce for unpredictability
- Self-healing integrity watchdog
- 42-column token schema

### Protection
- Unified rate limiting + burn credits
- Data verification layer ("Don't Trust, Verify")
- Comprehensive audit fixes (OWASP top 10)

---

### Card Generator v4
- 3 styles: HolDex (glassmorphism), ASDF (fire), Minimal (dark)
- 2x rendering for crisp output

### Dashboards
- `/cult-space` - Cult member dashboard with wallet auth
- `/track-record` - Trencher's Dashboard redesign
- `/admin` - Grant management

### Infrastructure
- PriceWorker with DexScreener batch API
- Helius webhook integration
- Discord alerting for credits & tampering
